dimensions.feedback: The recipe includes over 1.5 lbs of watery vegetables (zucchini, mushrooms), beans, and tomatoes, but specifies zero added salt or black pepper, relying entirely on a small amount of cheese for seasoning. This will result in a very bland, unbalanced base. Fix: Add 1/8 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp black pepper in step 3 to draw out the mushroom moisture and properly season the vegetables. This adds ~145 mg sodium per serving, keeping the total (450 mg) safely below the 550 mg chapter ceiling.
